<json>
{
  "states": [
    "ClientAwaitingResponse",
    "ClientCancelSent",
    "ClientTransactionComplete",
    "ServerProcessingCancel",
    "TransactionFound",
    "ServerDone"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "ClientAwaitingResponse",
      "event": "receive provisional_response",
      "action": "send CANCEL request",
      "to": "ClientCancelSent"
    },
    {
      "from": "ClientAwaitingResponse",
      "event": "receive final_response",
      "action": "do not send CANCEL",
      "to": "ClientTransactionComplete"
    },
    {
      "from": "ClientAwaitingResponse",
      "event": "timeout 64*T1",
      "action": "destroy client transaction",
      "to": "ClientTransactionComplete"
    },
    {
      "from": "ServerProcessingCancel",
      "event": "cond no matching transaction",
      "action": "reply 481",
      "to": "ServerDone"
    },
    {
      "from": "ServerProcessingCancel",
      "event": "cond matching transaction found",
      "action": "check final response status",
      "to": "TransactionFound"
    },
    {
      "from": "TransactionFound",
      "event": "cond final response sent",
      "action": "reply 200 OK",
      "to": "ServerDone"
    },
    {
      "from": "TransactionFound",
      "event": "cond no final response INVITE",
      "action": "reply 487 and 200",
      "to": "ServerDone"
    },
    {
      "from": "TransactionFound",
      "event": "cond no final response other",
      "action": "reply 200 OK",
      "to": "ServerDone"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
